project_info.theme: Cold glamour modern art exhibition portrait
project_info.color_palette: black, cool white, soft gray, neutral skin tones

main_subject.detail: An adult Asian woman with long flowing dark hair, realistic delicate skin texture, and a cool aloof high-end fashion presence. She wears a minimalist fitted black dress with clean tailoring and a square neckline, no embellishments.

items: standing beside a sculptural abstract installation
white gallery walls with ample negative space
slight weight shift and relaxed shoulder line
medium close-up above waist, installation softly blurred

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: cool overhead gallery lighting with soft structured facial fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: subtle dimensional shadows, edge highlights, moderate background preservation

technical_specs.render_style: 50mm portrait at f/2.8, fine film grain
technical_specs.color_treatment: low contrast, cool neutral gallery grade, visible natural skin texture

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-end cinematic fashion editorial of an adult Asian woman with long flowing dark hair and realistic delicate skin texture in a modern art exhibition. She wears a minimalist fitted black dress with clean tailoring and a square neckline, without embellishments. She stands beside an abstract sculptural installation against white gallery walls with ample negative space, shifting weight slightly with a relaxed shoulder line. Use a calm restrained direct gaze, medium close-up framed above waist, and a softly blurred but recognizable installation. Light with cool overhead gallery lighting and soft structured facial fill for subtle dimensional shadows and edge highlights. Keep a rational distant atmosphere, low contrast, fine film grain, natural skin texture, shallow depth, and 2:3 format.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. Optional approved-adult person, wardrobe, and art-installation references may be attached. Preserve adult identity, minimalist black dress, direct-gaze posture, gallery negative space, cool overhead lighting, and sculptural form; installation content may be replaced.

changes: Clarified the subject as an adult.
Replaced sexualized figure wording with a fitted fashion silhouette while preserving the black dress, gallery setting, and cool glamour intent.
